title: Query builder reads meta.facets: value dropdowns, geo fields, multi-value conditions (proposal step 5)
description: Step 5 of research/category-taxonomy-proposal.md. In app/src/query/model.ts, engine.ts, describe.ts, urlCodec.ts and QueryView.vue: when the selected field is a facet key (from meta.facets[type]) or a geo field (geo.country, geo.subdivision, geo.city), the condition editor offers a <select> (or multi-select) of the facet's values with counts instead of a free-text input; the operator set for facets is 'is any of' (multi-value, OR) and 'is not' ; free-text fields keep eq/contains/gte/lte/between unchanged. Add an 'in' operator to the query model with array values; urlCodec encodes arrays stably and keeps decoding every pre-existing link (backward compatibility is an AC). describe.ts renders the new conditions in plain English ("Facility type is any of Dry stack, Boatyard"). Field list groups facets under a 'Categories' heading and geo under 'Location'; raw attrs stay available under 'Attributes'. The engine evaluates facet conditions against attrs.facets and geo conditions against attrs.geo (never attrs.country, reviewer finding on TASK-027). Relationship conditions untouched. A 'Open in browse' action converts a single-type query with only facet/geo conditions into the equivalent /browse/:type URL from TASK-030, and the browse view offers 'Refine in query builder' doing the reverse. No ingest changes.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Choosing a facet or geo field in the condition editor shows a value dropdown populated from meta.facets / attrs.geo with counts; choosing a raw attribute still shows the existing text/number inputs (component test).

AC2: New 'in' (is any of) and 'not' operators exist in the query model with array values; engine returns exactly the rows whose attrs.facets / attrs.geo match (unit tests with fixtures, including multi-valued facets like services).
AC3: urlCodec encodes/decodes array values; every existing urlCodec test passes unchanged and a pinned corpus of 5 pre-existing query links decodes to the same model as before.
AC4: describe.ts renders facet and geo conditions in plain English; snapshot test for at least 3 conditions.
AC5: 'Open in browse' and 'Refine in query builder' round-trip: a browse selection converted to a query and back yields the identical URL (test).
AC6: Geo conditions evaluate against attrs.geo only; a fixture node with attrs.country 'Italy' and attrs.geo.country 'Netherlands' matches geo.country = Netherlands and not Italy.
AC7: Existing app tests green plus new tests <= AC count unless justified; typecheck and build clean; keyboard operable selects; UAT on /query by the human.
